**AVA (Aviso Virtual Assistant)** is your AI-powered onboarding companion designed to help you navigate and understand the Aviso platform faster and smarter. With interactive voice and chat support, guided walkthroughs, and instant access to relevant documentation, AVA ensures a seamless onboarding experience by providing real-time assistance and personalized insights at every step.

To access this feature, follow these steps:

1. First off, click the MIKI assistant button to access AI-powered insights and support features.

![](https://static.helpjuice.com/helpjuice_production/uploads/upload/image/29408/direct/1770212547592/image.png)
2. Next up, click the microphone button to enable voice input for your query and click the speaker icon to enable audio for AVA's virtual assistant guidance.
3. You can either talk to AVA or use the chatbox to get your queries answered. Aviso also provides you with automatically generated queries to help you better understand the platform.

![](https://static.helpjuice.com/helpjuice_production/uploads/upload/image/29408/direct/1770212547645/image.png)
4. Next up, click View Document to access the detailed integration documentation.![](https://static.helpjuice.com/helpjuice_production/uploads/upload/image/29408/direct/1770212547631/image.png)

![](https://static.helpjuice.com/helpjuice_production/uploads/upload/image/29408/direct/1770212547606/image.png)
